name: DS Cluster D10: Fundamentals (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow)
description: Tests: balance_sheet quarterly, income_statement quarterly, ffill for sparse fundamental data, PE ratio construction.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D10: Fundamentals
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === BALANCE SHEET (quarterly) ===
bs = balance_sheet(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
total_assets = ffill(bs.total_assets)
total_liabilities = ffill(bs.total_liabilities)
equity = ffill(bs.total_equity)

# === INCOME STATEMENT (quarterly) ===
inc = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
revenue = ffill(inc.revenue)
net_income = ffill(inc.net_income)
eps = ffill(inc.basic_eps)

# === DERIVED METRIC: trailing PE ratio ===
# EPS is quarterly; multiply by 4 for annualized estimate
annual_eps = eps * 4
pe_ratio = where(annual_eps > 0, close / annual_eps)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Revenue & Net Income (Quarterly, ffill'd)",
    category="Fundamentals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Revenue", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Net Income", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(revenue, net_income))

xy_lines(
    title="Trailing PE Ratio",
    category="Fundamentals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="PE", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=pe_ratio)

xy_lines(
    title="Equity vs Liabilities",
    category="Fundamentals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Equity", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Liabilities", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(equity, total_liabilities))
